x-fc-supplement.title: Sending a message to a group, and reading the group action, in communities
x-fc-supplement.source: communities tag v2.35.5 @ 2be913d45b123466cc9aa26a73343e9d2b1c68b1 (the one running in production on 2026-11-04), read only with git show
x-fc-supplement.reason: The portal's unified specification (13-10 snapshot) does not have the public group actions. These two are the ones the first use needs: send a message to a group and read how it went. The operationIds follow the Scramble form (class.method) and are not checked against a generated specification; the tag is the one communities documents them under (ApiDocsGroup::GroupActions). When the portal publishes a unified specification that has them, remove this supplement from the config.
x-fc-supplement.key_access: ApiRouteCatalog: POST groups/{group}/messages is Send (communities:send), GET groups/actions/{action} is Read (communities:read). Both are part of the public group actions, which the setting API_GROUP_ACTIONS_ENABLED turns on; it is true in production (communities-api, confirmed by the user on 2026-11-04).

tags.name: Acciones de grupo
tags.description: Asynchronous actions on a WhatsApp group, such as sending it a message: they answer 202 with an action_id, and their outcome is read with Get a group action or arrives in group_action.completed and group_action.failed.

post.summary: Send a message to a group

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The group's uid, as List groups returns it (for example 120363012345678901@g.us).

device_id.description: The number that sends: connected, and an admin of the group (a QR number) or the group's own number (an official one).

text.description: Only with type text, and required there.

media_url.description: Only with image, video, audio or document, and required there: a public https URL that ends in an extension WhatsApp accepts for the type.

file_name.description: Only with document: the name it arrives with.

post.x-fc-purpose: Sends a text or one media file to a WhatsApp group now, from one of your numbers. It answers at once with an action_id; the message goes out right after.

get.x-fc-purpose: Gets the status (queued, running, completed or failed) and the result of a group action, such as a message sent to a group.

type.description: send_message for a message to a group.

result.description: For a message, result.message.uid is its ID in WhatsApp.
